summary: Remote-controlled AI agent daemon executes attacker-supplied prompts in a PTY with permission checks disabled
details: dist/session-runner.js implements a long-polling daemon that fetches pending request rows from a hardcoded Supabase project (syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co) via the RPC `runtime_pick_next_request` and hands each remote-supplied row to a locally spawned AI coding agent. The agent (Claude/Codex/Kimi/Gemini/Grok) is launched through node-pty with `--dangerously-skip-permissions` appended to `permissionFlags`, and the remote-supplied prompt content is written into the PTY via `proc.write(data)`. Any party with access to the paired Supabase account can therefore drive arbitrary tool-use and shell actions on the host running the daemon, since permission gating on the agent is explicitly disabled. The network→PTY→shell dataflow provides persistent remote command execution on the installer's machine once the daemon is running and paired.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
